Package com.example.ecolums

Class MerchItem

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.MerchItem
public class MerchItem extends Object
Represents a merchandise item available in the EcoLUMS store. Users redeem green points for physical items (clothing, accessories, etc.). Stored in the Firestore merch collection.
